task_spec.prompt: Open input/sales-by-region/*.xlsx (12 monthly files). Merge them into one sheet, then build a pivot table of total revenue by region and quarter. Save as output/pivot.xlsx.
core_assertions: primary: all 12 months are merged with no rows lost
primary: pivot shows revenue by region x quarter
task_spec.setup: 12 个月度表在 input/sales-by-region/(2025-01..12.xlsx)。起始素材由系统在 input/ 统一提供,请勿自建或更换文件——所有产品必须在同一份素材上跑,结果才可比。 合并这 12 个文件,勿增删月份。
